browser_core: 0.3.1-alpha.1 (exact-retention calculation unchanged from the validated core)
annotation_extension: Automated tests cover marker-header parsing, evidence categories, grouped counts and CSV export fields.
limitations: The retention comparison establishes computational parity only. The integrated workbench has a single-assembly concordance check, not a sensitivity/specificity validation. AMR allele labels are closest nucleotide references; protein-level correction and QRDR, porin and colistin mutation logic are not implemented. Species and relatedness outputs remain screening results and no clinical phenotype, severity or direct transmission is inferred.
